namespace Peano
open KCore

/-- The executable step lists exactly `Step`'s successors. -/
theorem step_iff (x y : Config c) :
    Step c x y ↔ ∃ n, (Exec.successorsN c n x.val).any (Exec.same · y.val) = true :=
  Exec.step_iff_of_ok c ok srReady matchReady x y

/-- A step is by one of the rules, which applies to the configuration. -/
theorem step_cases {x y : Config c} (h : Step c x y) :
    ∃ i, ∃ hi : i < c.rules.length, Det.Applies c c.rules[i] x.val := by
  cases h with
  | rule r mem σ hσ hm hq _ _ =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem mem
    exact ⟨i, hi, σ, hσ, hm, hq⟩

/-! ## The rules -/

kernel_rfl rule0 : c.rules[0]? = some
  { vars := [Peano.Srt.«Nat», Peano.Srt.«Nat», KCore.Srt.counter],
    lhs := (.app KCore.topLabel [(.app Peano.Sym.«<k>» [(.app KCore.kseq [(.inj Peano.Srt.«State» KCore.Srt.kitem (.app Peano.Sym.«run» [(.as (.app Peano.Sym.«s» [(.var 0)]) 1)])), (.app KCore.dotk [])])]), (.var 2)]),
    req := none,
    rhs := (.app KCore.topLabel [(.app Peano.Sym.«<k>» [(.app KCore.kseq [(.inj Peano.Srt.«State» KCore.Srt.kitem (.app Peano.Sym.«run» [(.app Peano.Sym.«pred» [(.var 1)])])), (.app KCore.dotk [])])]), (.var 2)]),
    prio := 50 }

kernel_rfl rule1 : c.rules[1]? = some
  { vars := [Peano.Srt.«Nat», KCore.Srt.counter],
    lhs := (.app KCore.topLabel [(.app Peano.Sym.«<k>» [(.app KCore.kseq [(.inj Peano.Srt.«State» KCore.Srt.kitem (.app Peano.Sym.«run» [(.as (.app Peano.Sym.«z» []) 0)])), (.app KCore.dotk [])])]), (.var 1)]),
    req := none,
    rhs := (.app KCore.topLabel [(.app Peano.Sym.«<k>» [(.app KCore.kseq [(.inj Peano.Srt.«State» KCore.Srt.kitem (.app Peano.Sym.«done» [(.inj Peano.Srt.«Nat» Peano.Srt.«Val» (.var 0))])), (.app KCore.dotk [])])]), (.var 1)]),
    prio := 50 }

/-! ## The functions: signature, then each clause -/

kernel_rfl «fn_pred_sig» : (c.lookupFn Peano.Sym.«pred»).map (fun fn => (fn.args, fn.result, fn.clauses.length, fn.owise.isSome)) = some ([Peano.Srt.«Nat»], Peano.Srt.«Nat», 1, true)

/-
  Peano's nine statements, over the generated package `Peano` (`kcore gen`). The user's package:
  readable terms and the statements. Matching ranges over well-sorted substitutions, so the
  equations of `pred` are stated for `N` of sort `Nat`.
-/
import Peano

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Peano

open KCore

@[match_pattern, reducible] def z : GroundTerm := .ctor Sym.«z» []
@[match_pattern, reducible] def s (n : GroundTerm) : GroundTerm := .ctor Sym.«s» [n]
@[match_pattern, reducible] def run (n : GroundTerm) : GroundTerm := .ctor Sym.«run» [n]
@[match_pattern, reducible] def done (v : GroundTerm) : GroundTerm := .ctor Sym.«done» [v]
@[match_pattern, reducible] def natVal (n : GroundTerm) : GroundTerm := .inj Srt.«Nat» Srt.«Val» n
@[match_pattern, reducible] def counter (i : GroundTerm) : GroundTerm := .ctor counterLabel [i]
@[match_pattern, reducible] def top (k ctr : GroundTerm) : GroundTerm := .ctor topLabel [k, ctr]
@[match_pattern, reducible] def cfg (st ctr : GroundTerm) : GroundTerm :=
  top (.ctor Sym.«<k>» [.ctor kseq [.inj Srt.«State» KCore.Srt.kitem st, .ctor dotk []]]) ctr
def ctr0 : GroundTerm := counter (.dv KCore.Srt.int (.int 0))

abbrev Pred (n v : GroundTerm) : Prop := Eval c Sym.«pred» [n] (some v)

def deterministic.statement : Prop := ∀ x y y' : Config c, Step c x y → Step c x y' → y = y'
def pred_succ.statement : Prop := ∀ N : GroundTerm, c.sortOf N = some Srt.«Nat» → Pred (s N) N
def pred_owise.statement : Prop :=
  ∀ N : GroundTerm, c.sortOf N = some Srt.«Nat» → (∀ M, N ≠ s M) → Pred N z
def step_run_succ.statement : Prop :=
  ∃ x y : Config c, x.val = cfg (run (s z)) ctr0 ∧ y.val = cfg (run z) ctr0 ∧ Step c x y
def step_run_zero.statement : Prop :=
  ∃ x y : Config c, x.val = cfg (run z) ctr0 ∧ y.val = cfg (done (natVal z)) ctr0 ∧ Step c x y
def stuck_done.statement : Prop :=
  ∃ x : Config c, x.val = cfg (done (natVal z)) ctr0 ∧ ∀ y : Config c, ¬ Step c x y
def doneHoldsZero (x : Config c) : Prop := ∀ v ctr, x.val = cfg (done v) ctr → v = natVal z
def doneHoldsZero_fails.statement : Prop :=
  ∃ x : Config c, x.val = cfg (done (natVal (s z))) ctr0 ∧ ¬ doneHoldsZero x
def doneHoldsZero_preserved.statement : Prop :=
  ∀ x y : Config c, Step c x y → doneHoldsZero x → doneHoldsZero y
def counterIs (ctr : GroundTerm) (x : Config c) : Prop := ∃ k, x.val = top k ctr
def counter_preserved.statement : Prop :=
  ∀ (ctr : GroundTerm) (x y : Config c), Step c x y → counterIs ctr x → counterIs ctr y

end Peano

/-
  The decisions peano's witnesses and its guard invariant need (the user's: they are about the
  configurations and the position its statements name). Each is one kernel decision; sorts are read
  from the package's tables (`sortOfT`, `T_eq`).
-/
import User.Statements

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxRecDepth 1000000

namespace Peano

open KCore

theorem sorted_runSZ : c.sortOf (cfg (run (s z)) ctr0) = some topCellSort :=
  sortOf_of_T T_eq (by decide +kernel)
theorem sorted_runZ : c.sortOf (cfg (run z) ctr0) = some topCellSort :=
  sortOf_of_T T_eq (by decide +kernel)
theorem sorted_doneZ : c.sortOf (cfg (done (natVal z)) ctr0) = some topCellSort :=
  sortOf_of_T T_eq (by decide +kernel)
theorem sorted_doneSZ : c.sortOf (cfg (done (natVal (s z))) ctr0) = some topCellSort :=
  sortOf_of_T T_eq (by decide +kernel)
theorem succ_runSZ : (Exec.successorsN c 100 (cfg (run (s z)) ctr0)).any (Exec.same · (cfg (run z) ctr0)) = true := by
  decide +kernel
theorem succ_runZ :
    (Exec.successorsN c 100 (cfg (run z) ctr0)).any (Exec.same · (cfg (done (natVal z)) ctr0)) = true := by
  decide +kernel
theorem nomatch_doneZ : c.rules.all (fun r =>
    ((Exec.matchP c (Exec.patFuel [r.lhs]) [] r.lhs (cfg (done (natVal z)) ctr0)).filter
      (Exec.wellSorted c r.vars)).isEmpty) = true := by decide +kernel

/-- The first item of the k cell. -/
def kItemPath : Path := kPath ++ [.arg kseq 2 0, .inj KCore.Srt.kitem]
/-- After a step, a `done(_)` at the head of the k cell holds `z` (as a `Val`). -/
def doneGuard : Guard := { path := kItemPath, head := Sym.«done», sub := [.arg Sym.«done» 1 0], val := natVal z }

theorem guardDone : allExcept (guardOK c doneGuard) [] 0 c.rules = true := by decide +kernel

end Peano

userProofs.text:
/-
  Peano's nine properties, from the generated package (`Peano.deterministic`, `Peano.step_iff`,
  `Peano.counter_kept`) and the decisions of User/Facts.lean. No per-rule proof.
-/
import User.Facts

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Peano

open KCore

theorem deterministic' : deterministic.statement := fun _ _ _ h h' => deterministic h h'

private theorem lfPred : c.lookupFn Sym.«pred» = some (c.fns[0]'(by decide +kernel)) := rfl

theorem pred_succ : pred_succ.statement := fun N hN =>
  .clause (pre := []) (post := []) (σ := [(0, N)]) lfPred rfl (fun _ h => nomatch h)
    (fun i s h => by
      cases i with
      | zero => cases h; exact ⟨N, rfl, hN⟩
      | succ i => cases h)
    (.cons (.ctor rfl (.cons (.var rfl) .nil)) .nil) (fun _ h => nomatch h) .var

theorem pred_owise : pred_owise.statement := fun N _ hN =>
  .owise lfPred
    (fun cl hcl => by
      rw [List.mem_singleton.mp hcl]
      refine .intro fun σ _ hm => ?_
      cases hm with
      | cons h _ => cases h with
        | hook hp _ _ => exact absurd hp (by decide)
        | coll hc _ _ _ => exact absurd hc (by decide)
        | ctor _ hs => cases hs with
          | cons _ hs' => cases hs' with
            | nil => exact absurd rfl (hN _))
    rfl (.ctor rfl .nil)

theorem counterIs_iff (ctr v : GroundTerm) : (∃ k, v = top k ctr) ↔ v.atPath counterPath = some ctr := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩; rfl
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨vs, u, rfl, hl, hu, hw⟩ := GroundTerm.atPath_arg h
    cases hw
    match vs, hl, hu with
    | [k, _], _, hu => cases hu; exact ⟨k, rfl⟩

/-- The generated counter kind, with no obligations. -/
theorem counter_preserved : counter_preserved.statement := fun ctr x y hs hx => by
  have hf := counter_kept (fun _ h => nomatch h) x y hs
  exact (counterIs_iff ctr y.val).mpr (hf.trans ((counterIs_iff ctr x.val).mp hx))

theorem doneHoldsZero_preserved : doneHoldsZero_preserved.statement := fun x y hs _ v ctr hy => by
  have hg := steps_of (guard_sound doneGuard) guardDone (fun _ h => nomatch h) x y hs
  exact Option.some.inj (hg (done v) (by rw [hy]; rfl) rfl)

/-- With no match of any rule at x, the executable step lists nothing. -/
theorem successorsN_nil (n : Nat) (x : GroundTerm)
    (h : ∀ r ∈ c.rules, Exec.ruleMatches c n r x = []) : Exec.successorsN c n x = [] := by
  unfold Exec.successorsN
  have hf : (c.rules.map fun r => (r, Exec.ruleMatches c n r x)).filter
      (fun (_, l) => l.any fun (_, b) => b != some false) = [] :=
    List.filter_eq_nil_iff.mpr fun p hp => by
      obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hp
      simp [h r hr]
  simp only [hf, List.map_nil, List.min?_nil]

theorem stuck_of {x : Config c}
    (h : c.rules.all (fun r => ((Exec.matchP c (Exec.patFuel [r.lhs]) [] r.lhs x.val).filter
      (Exec.wellSorted c r.vars)).isEmpty) = true) (y : Config c) : ¬ Step c x y := by
  intro hs
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (step_iff x y).mp hs
  rw [successorsN_nil n x.val fun r hr => by
    simp only [Exec.ruleMatches, List.isEmpty_iff.mp (List.all_eq_true.mp h r hr), List.map_nil]] at hn
  cases hn

theorem step_run_succ : step_run_succ.statement :=
  let x : Config c := ⟨_, sorted_runSZ⟩
  let ⟨y, hy, hsy⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp succ_runSZ
  let ⟨hs, hst⟩ := Det.step_of_mem (x := x) ok srReady matchReady hy
  ⟨x, ⟨y, hs⟩, rfl, Exec.same_iff.mp hsy, hst⟩

theorem step_run_zero : step_run_zero.statement :=
  let x : Config c := ⟨_, sorted_runZ⟩
  let ⟨y, hy, hsy⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp succ_runZ
  let ⟨hs, hst⟩ := Det.step_of_mem (x := x) ok srReady matchReady hy
  ⟨x, ⟨y, hs⟩, rfl, Exec.same_iff.mp hsy, hst⟩

theorem stuck_done : stuck_done.statement := ⟨⟨_, sorted_doneZ⟩, rfl, stuck_of nomatch_doneZ⟩

theorem doneHoldsZero_fails : doneHoldsZero_fails.statement :=
  ⟨⟨_, sorted_doneSZ⟩, rfl, fun h => by
    have := h (natVal (s z)) ctr0 rfl
    injection this with _ _ h'
    injection h' with h''
    exact absurd h'' (by decide)⟩

-- the axioms of all nine
#eval show Lean.CoreM Unit from do
  for n in [``deterministic', ``pred_succ, ``pred_owise, ``step_run_succ, ``step_run_zero, ``stuck_done,
      ``doneHoldsZero_fails, ``doneHoldsZero_preserved, ``counter_preserved] do
    let axs ← Lean.collectAxioms n
    unless axs.all ([``propext, ``Classical.choice, ``Quot.sound].contains ·) do
      throwError "{n}: axioms {axs}"

end Peano

userCert.text:
/-
  A run certificate on peano (KcoreSpec/Cert.lean): `run(s(s(z)))` reaches `done(z)` in three
  steps (rules 0, 0, 1), and `done(z)` is stuck. Each check is one kernel decision; soundness is the
  generic `Cert.checkRun_sound` from the package's three conditions.
-/
import User.Statements
import KcoreSpec.Cert

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxRecDepth 1000000

namespace Peano.CertTest

open KCore KCore.Cert Peano

def runs : List (Nat × GroundTerm) :=
  [(0, cfg (run (s z)) ctr0), (0, cfg (run z) ctr0), (1, cfg (done (natVal z)) ctr0)]

theorem peano_run : checkRun c 100 (cfg (run (s (s z))) ctr0) runs (cfg (done (natVal z)) ctr0) = true := by
  decide +kernel
theorem peano_stuck : stuckCheck c 100 (cfg (done (natVal z)) ctr0) = true := by decide +kernel

/-- `run(s(s(z)))` reaches `done(z)`, and `done(z)` has no successor. -/
theorem peano_reaches :
    ∃ (hs : c.sortOf (cfg (run (s (s z))) ctr0) = some topCellSort)
      (hf : c.sortOf (cfg (done (natVal z)) ctr0) = some topCellSort),
      Reach (Step c) ⟨_, hs⟩ ⟨_, hf⟩ ∧ ∀ y, ¬ Step c ⟨_, hf⟩ y :=
  let ⟨hs, hf, hr⟩ := checkRun_sound ok srReady matchReady peano_run
  ⟨hs, hf, hr, stuckCheck_sound ok srReady matchReady (x := ⟨_, hf⟩) peano_stuck⟩

/-- info: 'Peano.CertTest.peano_reaches' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
#guard_msgs in
#print axioms peano_reaches

end Peano.CertTest

coreTerms.text:
/-- A literal: an Int, a Bool, or the text of a token (`Id`, `String`, `KConfigVar`). -/
inductive Lit where
  | int (i : Int)
  | bool (b : Bool)
  | tok (s : String)
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

/-- A term of a clause or a rule: a variable, an application, an injection between sorts, an
alias (`p #as V`), or a domain value. `app` applies a constructor, a
function of the definition, or an interpreted hooked symbol (FixedSignature.lean). -/
inductive Term where
  | var (i : Nat)
  | app (f : Sym) (args : List Term)
  | inj (a b : Srt) (t : Term)
  | as (t : Term) (i : Nat)
  | dv (s : Srt) (lit : Lit)
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

/-- A ground value (Value.lean has its order, its sorts and its laws). -/
inductive GroundTerm where
  | ctor (f : Sym) (args : List GroundTerm)
  | inj (a b : Srt) (t : GroundTerm)
  | dv (s : Srt) (lit : Lit)
  /-- a finite map of the collection sort `s`: entries `(key, value)`, keys strictly increasing
  in `GroundTerm.cmp`. The sort tells apart maps of different collection sorts with the same
  entries (the empty `Map` and the empty `AccountCellMap`). -/
  | map (s : Srt) (es : List (GroundTerm × GroundTerm))
  /-- a finite set of the collection sort `s`: elements strictly increasing in `GroundTerm.cmp` -/
  | set (s : Srt) (es : List GroundTerm)
  /-- a finite list of the collection sort `s`: its elements in order -/
  | list (s : Srt) (es : List GroundTerm)

coreRule.text:
/-- A rewrite rule `lhs => rhs requires req` between configurations (ensures is `\top`), with
its priority (smaller first; 50 by default, 200 for `[owise]`). -/
structure Rule where
  vars : List Srt
  lhs : Term
  req : Option Term
  rhs : Term
  prio : Nat

coreSemantics.text:
structure Semantics where
  /-- the builtin library: the union of the imported modules' sorts, subsorts and constructors
  (Builtins.lean) -/
  lib : Lib
  /-- the names of the definition's own sorts (numbered from `nRegSorts`), without `Sort` -/
  sortNames : List String
  /-- the names of the definition's own symbols (numbered from `nRegSyms`) -/
  symNames : List String
  userSorts : List Srt
  ctors : List CtorSig
  fns : List Fn
  userSubsorts : List (Srt × Srt)
  /-- the sort of `$PGM` (a user sort, `K` or `KItem`) -/
  pgmSort : Srt
  rules : List Rule
  /-- the user's configuration: its top-level cells (`<k> $PGM </k>` and `<T>…</T>` are one
  cell each, `<k/> <env/>` two) -/
  config : List Cell
  /-- the parameter symbols: the imported modules' symbols no hook interprets (registry numbers),
  then the definition's own hooked symbols (numbered after its functions) -/
  params : List ParamSig := []
  /-- the definition's own collection sorts (cell collections), besides the library's `Map`,
  `Set` and `List` (`builtinColls`) -/
  colls : List CollSig := []
  /-- the meaning of the parameter symbols that no registry hook interprets. Theorems about
  a definition with parameters are stated for every `hooks` (`withHooks`); no decided condition
  reads this field, so a condition decided on the parsed data holds for every interpretation by
  `rfl` (`*_withHooks` lemmas, Exec.lean and Determinism.lean). -/
  hooks : HookParams := HookParams.none

regCounts.text:
/-- The number of registry sorts; a definition's own sorts are numbered from here. -/
def nRegSorts : Nat := 21 + BuiltinNames.nNewSorts

regSyms.text:
/-- The number of registry symbols; a definition's own symbols are numbered from here. -/
def nRegSyms : Nat := 173 + BuiltinNames.nNewSyms + 1

valueSortOf.text:
def sortOf : GroundTerm → Option Srt
    | .ctor f ts => match lookupSig c.ctorSigs f with
      | some k => if sortsOf ts == some k.args then some k.result else none
      | none => none
    | .inj a b t => if c.subsorts.contains (a, b) && !t.isInj && sortOf t == some a then some b
                    else none
    | .dv s lit => if dvOK c.lib s lit then some s else none

valueConfig.text:
def Value (c : Semantics) (s : Srt) : Type := { t : GroundTerm // c.sortOf t = some s }

abbrev Config (c : Semantics) : Type := Value c topCellSort

patVal.text:
/-- `PatVal c σ p v`: the left-hand-side pattern `p` denotes `v` under σ. Constructors build
  constructor terms; the map symbols allowed in patterns (`.Map`, `|->`, `_Map_`) denote their
  values (`hook`), so `K |-> V M` denotes the union of the singleton with M, defined only when
  K is not a key of M: the matches modulo associativity, commutativity and unit are exactly the
  σ under which the pattern denotes the map. A collection pattern symbol (`isCollPat`: a list's,
  or a cell map's) denotes the collection its operation builds from the parts' values (`collVal`),
  so `ListItem(P) L` denotes every list whose first element P denotes and whose rest L denotes. A
  constructor's pattern keeps its constructor meaning (`hc`). -/
  inductive PatVal (c : Semantics) (σ : Subst) : Term → GroundTerm → Prop where
    | var {i : Nat} {v : GroundTerm} (h : σ.lookup i = some v) : PatVal c σ (.var i) v
    | dv {s : Srt} {lit : Lit} : PatVal c σ (.dv s lit) (.dv s lit)
    | ctor {f : Sym} {ps : List Term} {vs : List GroundTerm}
        (h : c.isCtor f = true) (hs : PatVals c σ ps vs) : PatVal c σ (.app f ps) (.ctor f vs)
    | hook {f : Sym} {ps : List Term} {vs : List GroundTerm} {v : GroundTerm}
        (hp : patternHooks.contains f = true) (hs : PatVals c σ ps vs)
        (hv : hook f vs = some (some v)) : PatVal c σ (.app f ps) v
    | inj {a b : Srt} {p : Term} {w : GroundTerm} (h : PatVal c σ p w) :
        PatVal c σ (.inj a b p) (injNormal a b w)
    | coll {f : Sym} {ps : List Term} {vs : List GroundTerm} {v : GroundTerm}
        (hc : c.isCtor f = false) (hp : c.isCollPat f = true) (hs : PatVals c σ ps vs)
        (hv : c.collVal f vs = some v) :
        PatVal c σ (.app f ps) v
    | as {p : Term} {i : Nat} {v : GroundTerm} (h : PatVal c σ p v) (hi : σ.lookup i = some v) :
        PatVal c σ (.as p i) v

evalEval.text:
/-- `Eval c f vs r`: the function `f` of `c` at `vs` has the result `r` (`none`: undefined). -/
  inductive Eval (c : Semantics) : Sym → List GroundTerm → Option GroundTerm → Prop where
    /-- The first clause that applies decides: its patterns denote `vs` under a well-sorted σ,
    and its `requires` evaluates to `true` under σ; the clauses before it fail. -/
    | clause {f : Sym} {fn : Fn} {vs : List GroundTerm} {pre post : List Clause} {cl : Clause}
        {σ : Subst} {r : Option GroundTerm}
        (hfn : c.lookupFn f = some fn)
        (hcls : fn.clauses = pre ++ cl :: post)
        (hpre : ∀ cl' ∈ pre, Fails c vs cl')
        (hσ : c.WellSorted cl.vars σ)
        (hmatch : PatVals c σ cl.pats vs)
        (hreq : ∀ t, cl.req = some t → EvalTerm c σ t (some (bool true)))
        (hrhs : EvalTerm c σ cl.rhs r) : Eval c f vs r
    /-- Where every clause fails, the catch-all clause gives the result. -/
    | owise {f : Sym} {fn : Fn} {vs : List GroundTerm} {o : Owise} {r : Option GroundTerm}
        (hfn : c.lookupFn f = some fn)
        (hnone : ∀ cl ∈ fn.clauses, Fails c vs cl)
        (ho : fn.owise = some o)
        (hrhs : EvalTerm c (argSubst 0 vs) o.rhs r) : Eval c f vs r
    /-- Where every clause fails and there is no catch-all clause, `f` is undefined. -/
    | undef {f : Sym} {fn : Fn} {vs : List GroundTerm}
        (hfn : c.lookupFn f = some fn)
        (hnone : ∀ cl ∈ fn.clauses, Fails c vs cl)
        (ho : fn.owise = none) : Eval c f vs none

evalTerm.text:
/-- `EvalTerm c σ t r`: the right-hand side (or `requires`) `t` has the result `r` under σ. -/
  inductive EvalTerm (c : Semantics) : Subst → Term → Option GroundTerm → Prop where
    | var {σ : Subst} {i : Nat} : EvalTerm c σ (.var i) (σ.lookup i)
    | dv {σ : Subst} {s : Srt} {lit : Lit} : EvalTerm c σ (.dv s lit) (some (.dv s lit))
    | inj {σ : Subst} {a b : Srt} {t : Term} {r : Option GroundTerm} (h : EvalTerm c σ t r) :
        EvalTerm c σ (.inj a b t) (r.map (injNormal a b))
    /-- A constructor of `c` builds the constructor term (undefined if an argument is). -/
    | ctor {σ : Subst} {f : Sym} {ts : List Term} {rs : List (Option GroundTerm)}
        (h : c.isCtor f = true) (hts : EvalTerms c σ ts rs) :
        EvalTerm c σ (.app f ts) ((allSome rs).map (.ctor f))

step.text:
/-- `RuleReqFails c σ r`: the rule has a `requires` whose result under σ is not `true`. -/
inductive RuleReqFails (c : Semantics) (σ : Subst) (r : Rule) : Prop where
  | intro {t : Term} {v : Option GroundTerm} (ht : r.req = some t) (he : EvalTerm c σ t v)
      (hv : v ≠ some (bool true)) : RuleReqFails c σ r

/-- `NotApplies c r x`: rule r does not apply to x: under every well-sorted σ under which its
left-hand side denotes x, its `requires` evaluates to something other than `true`. -/
def NotApplies (c : Semantics) (r : Rule) (x : GroundTerm) : Prop :=
  ∀ σ, c.WellSorted r.vars σ → PatVal c σ r.lhs x → RuleReqFails c σ r

inductive Step (c : Semantics) : Config c → Config c → Prop where
  | rule {x y : Config c} (r : Rule) (mem : r ∈ c.rules) (σ : Subst)
      (hσ : c.WellSorted r.vars σ)
      (hmatch : PatVal c σ r.lhs x.val)
      (hreq : ∀ t, r.req = some t → EvalTerm c σ t (some (bool true)))
      (heval : EvalTerm c σ r.rhs (some y.val))
      (hprio : ∀ r' ∈ c.rules, r'.prio < r.prio → NotApplies c r' x.val) : Step c x y

successors.text:
/-- A rule's matches at x, each with its `requires`: `some true` (applies), `some false` (does
not), `none` (out of fuel). -/
def ruleMatches (c : Semantics) (n : Nat) (r : Rule) (x : GroundTerm) : List (Subst × Option Bool) :=
  ((matchP c (patFuel [r.lhs]) [] r.lhs x).filter (wellSorted c r.vars)).map fun σ =>
    (σ, match r.req with
      | none => some true
      | some t => (evalT c n σ t).map isTrue)

/-- The successors of a configuration with `n` units of evaluation fuel: among the rules that
apply (or might, out of fuel), those of the smallest priority; for each of their matches whose
`requires` is `true`, the configuration the right-hand side evaluates to. -/
def successorsN (c : Semantics) (n : Nat) (x : GroundTerm) : List GroundTerm :=
  let ms := c.rules.map fun r => (r, ruleMatches c n r x)
  let applying := ms.filter fun (_, l) => l.any fun (_, b) => b != some false
  match (applying.map (·.1.prio)).min? with
  | none => []
  | some p =>
    (applying.filter (·.1.prio == p)).flatMap fun (r, l) =>
      l.filterMap fun (σ, b) =>
        if b == some true then match evalT c n σ r.rhs with
          | some (some y) => if c.sortOf y == some topCellSort then some y else none
          | _ => none
        else none

stepIffOk.text:
theorem step_iff_of_ok (c : Semantics) (hok : c.ok = true) (hsr : c.srReady = true)
    (hmr : c.matchReady = true) (x y : Config c) :
    Step c x y ↔ ∃ n, (successorsN c n x.val).any (same · y.val) = true := by

wf.text:
def wf (d : Definition) : Bool :=
  d.namesOK && d.sem.okAll && d.cert.ok d.sem && d.pres.ok d.sem && d.paramsOK

tied.text:
/-- `Tied k`: k is the emitted KORE of a well-formed definition, up to sentence order.
Irreducible: unfolding it runs `parse` on k, which the elaborator would otherwise do whenever it
compares a type with `Tied k`; the kernel unfolds it all the same. -/
@[irreducible] def Tied (k : Kore.Definition) : Prop :=
  match Parse.parse k with
  | some d => wf d = true ∧ KoreAML.Reordered d.emit k
  | none => False

reordered.text:
/-- `Reordered e k`: the KORE definitions e and k are equal except for the order of the sentences
inside each module. They have the same attributes and the same modules in the same order; each
module keeps its name and attributes; its sentences are a permutation of the other's, counting
repetitions. The order carries no meaning: a module's sentences declare a set of sorts and symbols
and state a set of axioms, and a sentence may use a sort or symbol declared after it. That
reordering leaves the theory's models unchanged is `sameModels_of_reordered` (ReorderTheory.lean). -/
def Reordered (e k : Kore.Definition) : Prop :=
  e.attributes = k.attributes ∧ e.modules.length = k.modules.length ∧
  ∀ mm ∈ e.modules.zip k.modules,
    mm.1.name = mm.2.name ∧ mm.1.attributes = mm.2.attributes ∧ mm.1.sentences.Perm mm.2.sentences

detOf.text:
theorem deterministic_of (hok : c.ok = true) (hsr : c.srReady = true) (hmr : c.matchReady = true)
    {T : Tables} (hT : T = tables c)
    {ix : DetIndex} (hd : detOK c T ix = true) {x y y' : Config c} (h : Step c x y) (h' : Step c x y') : y = y' :=

detOK.text:
/-- The condition: the index is the rules', and every row is fine. -/
def detOKExcept (c : Semantics) (T : Tables) (ix : DetIndex) (ovl : List (Nat × Nat)) : Bool :=
  idxOK c T ix && detRows c T ix ovl 0 c.rules.length

/-- `detOKExcept` with no pair excepted. -/
def detOK (c : Semantics) (T : Tables) (ix : DetIndex) : Bool := detOKExcept c T ix []

apart.text:
/-- Rules r and r' never both apply to one configuration. -/
def apart (c : Semantics) (T : Tables) (r r' : Rule) : Bool :=
  match meet c T r.vars r'.vars r.lhs r'.lhs with
  | none => true
  | some C => clashes c T r'.vars (litsL (envOf C) r ++ litsR r')

stepsOf.text:
/-- `RuleSteps c r P`: every step by rule r has the property P: under every well-sorted σ under
which its left-hand side denotes x, its `requires` holds and its right-hand side evaluates to y,
`P x y`. The form of a named obligation. -/
def RuleSteps (c : Semantics) (r : Rule) (P : GroundTerm → GroundTerm → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ σ x y, c.WellSorted r.vars σ → PatVal c σ r.lhs x →
    (∀ t, r.req = some t → EvalTerm c σ t (some (bool true))) → EvalTerm c σ r.rhs (some y) → P x y

/-- The rules from index `i` on satisfy `cond`, except those whose index is in `obl`. -/
def allExcept (cond : Rule → Bool) (obl : List Nat) : Nat → List Rule → Bool
  | _, [] => true
  | i, r :: rs => (obl.contains i || cond r) && allExcept cond obl (i + 1) rs

theorem allExcept_get {cond : Rule → Bool} {obl : List Nat} :
    ∀ (rs : List Rule) (i j : Nat) (r : Rule), allExcept cond obl i rs = true → rs[j]? = some r →
      obl.contains (i + j) = true ∨ cond r = true
  | [], _, _, _, _, h => nomatch h
  | r' :: rs, i, j, r, h, hj => by
    simp only [allExcept, Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.or_eq_true] at h
    cases j with
    | zero =>
      simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.some.injEq] at hj
      subst hj
      simpa using h.1
    | succ j =>
      simp only [List.getElem?_cons_succ] at hj
      have := allExcept_get rs (i + 1) j r h.2 hj
      rwa [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm 1 j] at this

/-- **The generic theorem.** If `cond` gives P for each step of a rule (`sound`), every rule not
listed in `obl` satisfies `cond` (one decision), and every listed rule is an obligation proved,
then every step has P. -/
theorem steps_of {c : Semantics} {P : GroundTerm → GroundTerm → Prop} {cond : Rule → Bool}
    (sound : ∀ r, cond r = true → RuleSteps c r P) {obl : List Nat}
    (h : allExcept cond obl 0 c.rules = true)
    (ho : ∀ i ∈ obl, ∀ r, c.rules[i]? = some r → RuleSteps c r P) :
    ∀ x y : Config c, Step c x y → P x.val y.val := by

allExcept.text:
/-- The rules from index `i` on satisfy `cond`, except those whose index is in `obl`. -/
def allExcept (cond : Rule → Bool) (obl : List Nat) : Nat → List Rule → Bool
  | _, [] => true
  | i, r :: rs => (obl.contains i || cond r) && allExcept cond obl (i + 1) rs

frameOK.text:
/-- The subterm at p is the same before and after the step. -/
def Frame (p : Path) (x y : GroundTerm) : Prop := y.atPath p = x.atPath p

/-- Rule r keeps the subterm at p: the left-hand side binds a variable there that the right-hand
side has there. -/
def frameOK (c : Semantics) (p : Path) (r : Rule) : Bool :=
  match Term.atPath c p r.lhs, Term.atPath c p r.rhs with
  | some (.var j), some (.var j') => j == j'
  | some (.as _ j), some (.var j') => j == j'
  | _, _ => false

certTerm.text:
theorem term_run : checkRun c 100 term_start term_steps term_final = true := by decide +kernel

/-- krust's run is a run of `Step`. -/
theorem term_reaches : ∃ (hs : c.sortOf term_start = some topCellSort) (hf : c.sortOf term_final = some topCellSort),
    Reach (Step c) ⟨_, hs⟩ ⟨_, hf⟩ :=
  checkRun_sound ok srReady matchReady term_run

theorem term_stuck : stuckCheck c 100 term_final = true := by decide +kernel

/-- The run's last configuration has no successor. -/
theorem term_ends (hf : c.sortOf term_final = some topCellSort) : ∀ y, ¬ Step c ⟨_, hf⟩ y :=
  stuckCheck_sound ok srReady matchReady (x := ⟨_, hf⟩) term_stuck

checkRunSound.text:
theorem checkRun_sound {n : Nat} {start final : GroundTerm} {steps : List (Nat × GroundTerm)}
    (h : checkRun c n start steps final = true) :
    ∃ (hs : c.sortOf start = some topCellSort) (hf : c.sortOf final = some topCellSort),
      Reach (Step c) ⟨start, hs⟩ ⟨final, hf⟩ := by

peanoK:
module PEANO
  syntax Nat ::= "z" [symbol(z)]
               | s(Nat) [symbol(s)]
  syntax Nat ::= pred(Nat) [function, symbol(pred)]
  rule pred(s(N)) => N
  rule pred(_) => z [owise]

  syntax Val ::= Nat
  syntax State ::= run(Nat) [symbol(run)]
                 | done(Val) [symbol(done)]

  configuration <k> $PGM:State </k>

  rule <k> run(s(N)) => run(pred(s(N))) </k>
  rule <k> run(z) => done(z) </k>
endmodule

report.condition: names declared once, none named like a hook, functions named apart, own sorts and symbols numbered in order
subsorts: a strict partial order into user sorts, closed
cells: named apart, one k cell of content K
rules: well-sorted over the configuration sort

krun.command: krust krun -m PEANO -s State -e 'run(s(s(z)))' --depth D peano.k
